logp.method_description: Partition coefficients (log P) of 1–4 and cisplatin in n-octanol/water were determined by the classical shake flask method using the standard protocol [30]. Two parallel experiments were performed for each sample and the amount of the complexes in the n-octanol phase was analysed by UV–Vis measurements.

Partition coefficients (log P) of the trans-configured complexes and cisplatin in n-octanol/water were determined by the classical shake flask method.3 Three parallel experiments were performed for each sample and the amount of the complexes in the n-octanol phase was analyzed by UV-vis measurements.
